description: This file implements a Cloudflare-specific chat model class for a language model interface. It includes error handling, configuration, request/response transformation, and an iterator for streaming response chunks. The file contains a class for cloudflare API interaction, a custom exception, and a response iterator class.

classes.name: CloudflareError
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling Cloudflare API related errors. It captures status code, message, request, and response details during instantiation.

classes.name: CloudflareChatConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Cloudflare chat model settings, supports environment validation, URL construction, parameter mapping, request/response transformation, and supported parameter listing.

classes.name: CloudflareChatResponseIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for processing streaming chunks from Cloudflare API responses, parsing JSON chunks into structured streaming chunk objects.
